company.shortDescription: Averda is a waste management and recycling company operating across the Middle East, Africa, and India.
company.description: Averda is an environmental services company that provides waste management, recycling, and resource recovery solutions for municipalities, commercial businesses, industrial facilities, and large-scale events. The company operates across multiple countries in the Middle East, Africa, and South Asia, supporting waste collection, sorting, treatment, landfill management, and recycling activities. Averda also works on sustainability initiatives focused on reducing landfill dependency, improving recycling rates, and promoting circular economy practices through integrated waste handling and environmental services.
